title: Artifact contract & compatibility matrix for embedding + reranker model onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: We currently accept many ad-hoc model artifacts for embedding + reranker candidates which leads to brittle onboarding, missed perf regressions, and repeated manual fixes when pinning variants. This ticket establishes a machine-readable artifact contract (manifest v2) and a compatibility matrix that CI and the Console can use to: 1) validate candidate bundles (shapes, ops, quantization metadata); 2) auto-generate performance profile templates for common infra targets; and 3) offer a safe rollback/canary plan when a pinned variant degrades.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest v2 schema defined and published in Confluence (fields documented + example JSON)
A CI validator that runs on PRs and rejects artifacts missing required fields or with unsupported ops
Compatibility matrix populated for 3 representative hardware targets (A100, T4, x86-quantized) with basic pass/fail columns
Profile publish flow updated to accept auto-generated profile templates and attach them to the artifact bundle in the catalog
Rollback script and canary tagging documented; Console can display a fallback variant for any pinned model
steps: Draft manifest v2 schema (include: model_id, architecture, quant_scheme, op_blacklist, shape_hints, kv_cache_format, supported_sequence_lengths, perf_hint) — Maya
Prototype CI validator using existing artifact-checker; add new rules and test vectors — Liam
Run compatibility sweep for three internal encoder+ranks using dedicated infra and record pass/fail — SRE pairing
Add mapping code to runtime to prefer 'compatibility_tag' when routing requests and fall back to compat-compatible variant
Update Console UI contract to surface profile template link and rollback button (PM + Design handoff)
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem for ENG-54211 where a reranker pin caused a 12% p99 token latency regression. Root cause: missing quantization metadata and an unnoticed op fallback path.
2025-02-13 Liam O'Neal: Spike completed — initial manifest v2 draft attached to Confluence. Decided to require 'kv_cache_format' and 'supported_sequence_lengths' to enable deterministic profiling.
2025-02-15 Design review (Aisha Patel): Console rollback interaction flows look good; requested an explicit 'safety-check' modal if rollback affects >1000 tps customers.
2025-02-17 SRE (Ravi Gupta): Ran compatibility sweep on A100 and T4. Summary: 2 of 3 candidates passed on A100, 1 failed on T4 due to an unsupported fused_op. Added failing binary to test vectors.
2025-02-18 Maya: Updated CI validator to return structured errors and link to remediation doc. Pushed prototype PR: runtime/pull/1372
2025-02-19 Product (Noah Kim): Agreed acceptance list. Request to expose 'compatibility_tag' in the profiles API so downstream customers can inspect before pinning.
2025-02-20 Liam: Second iteration of validator now blocks merges if op_blacklist is not present or if perf_hint is missing. Next: wire profile template generation into catalog publisher.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly strict manifest rules will block valid community models — Mitigation: provide a 'compatibility-compat' tier and clear remediation docs
Risk: CI validator runtime slowdown — Mitigation: run heavy binary checks on an opt-in nightly job; lightweight schema checks on PRs
Risk: Incorrect auto-generated profile leads to bad pin decisions — Mitigation: conservative defaults + require manual sign-off for P0 customers
